fixes.e: Privacy filters narrow the viewing angle so the screen looks dark from the sides. Anti-glare, tempered glass, and blue-light films change reflections, durability, or color output, not who can see the display.

o: Let it cool before using or charging it
Fully drain the battery, then recharge it
Move it to a refrigerator to cool it faster
Perform a factory reset to clear the warning
fixes.e: Lithium batteries must not charge at high temperature, so the device blocks charging until it returns to a safe range on its own. Rapid chilling in a refrigerator causes condensation inside the phone, and neither a discharge cycle nor a reset changes the battery's temperature.

o: It increases the base clock speed of each core
It allows a single thread to complete twice as fast
It can execute several threads truly in parallel
It doubles the amount of on-die cache available
fixes.e: Multiple physical cores let the CPU run several threads at the same time, improving multitasking and multithreaded workloads. Adding cores does not raise each core's clock speed, speed up an individual thread, or determine how much cache the die carries.

The print head contains a row of tiny heating elements that darken thermally coated paper or melt ribbon ink onto the media. The platen roller only backs and advances the media, the ribbon supplies ink rather than heat, and fuser assemblies belong to laser printers.

A docking station or USB-C hub expands a laptop's single port into wired networking, external displays, and extra peripherals at once. An Ethernet adapter or display adapter covers only one of those needs, and a KVM switch shares one set of peripherals between computers.

o: Order a replacement trackpad and install it
Power off the device and replace the swollen battery
Reinstall the touchpad driver to restore the click
Recalibrate the battery in the vendor utility
fixes.e: A bulging case means a swollen lithium-ion battery, which is a fire hazard. Power the device off and replace the battery. The trackpad stops clicking because the swelling pack presses against it from below, so trackpad hardware or software fixes miss the real cause.

o: Send the laptop out for depot-level repair
Replace the key caps or keyboard assembly
Exchange the laptop for a refurbished unit
Attach an external Bluetooth keyboard instead
fixes.x: Several keys have snapped off a laptop's built-in keyboard. Which is generally the MOST cost-effective repair?
fixes.e: Key caps and laptop keyboard assemblies are inexpensive replacement parts, and individual caps often snap back onto the scissor mechanism. Depot service or a replacement laptop costs far more, and an external keyboard is a workaround rather than a repair.

o: An IR webcam with facial recognition
A TPM chip on the system board
fixes.e: A physical shutter or kill switch blocks or disconnects the camera regardless of what software is running. TPMs, fingerprint readers, and IR cameras handle authentication and key storage; none of them can stop malware from streaming the webcam.

o: A rugged case and tempered screen protector
A slim silicone skin and camera lens film
A belt holster and microfiber pouch
A vinyl skin wrap and anti-glare film
fixes.e: Rugged cases and tempered glass are built to absorb drop impacts. Slim skins, vinyl wraps, and carry pouches mainly guard against scratches or protect the device only while it is stowed, which does little on an active job site.

Remote wipe erases the device or its corporate partition over the air, so data on lost or stolen hardware stays protected. Allow listing, screen-capture controls, and inventory reports manage devices in use but do nothing once the phone is gone.

o: In a configuration profile pushed over the air
Through the carrier's firmware update channel
In a setup wizard run once at first boot
fixes.e: MDM platforms deliver requirements like passcodes and encryption in configuration profiles pushed over the air to enrolled devices. Carrier firmware updates and SIM provisioning carry network settings, and the first-boot wizard only enrolls the device rather than delivering ongoing policy.

fixes.x: A technician inserts a USB flash drive containing an OS installer, but the PC keeps starting the existing operating system from the internal drive. Which BIOS/UEFI setting should be changed?
A technician suspects that overlapping access points are degrading performance across an office floor. Which tool shows nearby SSIDs, their channels, and signal strength?
fixes.e: A Wi-Fi analyzer maps surrounding networks by SSID, channel, and signal strength, revealing co-channel congestion and guiding channel selection; a spectrum analyzer sees raw RF energy but cannot decode SSIDs.

fixes.x: A high-performance CPU repeatedly overheats under sustained full load even though the case already has good airflow. Which cooling method can best handle this thermal load?
Which type of video output is standard on current graphics cards, carries both video and audio over one cable, and supports high refresh rates?
fixes.e: DisplayPort is the modern digital interface on current graphics cards, carrying high-resolution video and audio at high refresh rates; DVI-D is digital but omits audio, and VGA and S-Video are legacy analog standards.

fixes.x: A computer runs fine at idle but shuts down abruptly a few minutes into demanding workloads, and its case fans race at full speed before it cuts out. What is the MOST likely cause?
fixes.e: Load-only shutdowns with fans at full speed point to thermal protection tripping: check for dust buildup, blocked airflow, or dried thermal paste.

fixes.e: A grinding or buzzing noise that changes with system activity points to a moving part, and the classic culprit is a cooling fan with worn bearings. Solid-state drives, memory modules, and CMOS batteries have no moving parts and cannot produce mechanical noise.

fixes.x: File operations that once took seconds now take minutes on a workstation with a mechanical hard drive, and drive health checks show no failing hardware. Which action is the BEST fix?
fixes.e: Mechanical drives slow as they fill and fragment because the heads must seek across scattered pieces of every file. Freeing disk space and defragmenting restores contiguous reads; page-file, driver, and visual-effect changes do not address the drive itself. An SSD upgrade is the longer-term cure.

o: Try a different cable and USB port

A battery that no longer holds a full charge
A power adapter with insufficient wattage
Uninstall unused apps and delete unneeded files
Force-stop every app running in the background
Turn off the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth radios
Install a third-party battery saver app
fixes.e: When internal storage is nearly full the operating system has little room for caches, app data, and temporary files, so the whole device slows down. Uninstalling unused apps and deleting files frees that space and restores responsiveness; force-stopping apps or disabling radios changes nothing lasting, and a battery saver app can slow the device further.
